# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This batch of ~150 short call snippets is overwhelmingly **operations/relationship noise**: Diwali-gift (sweet box + kettle) distribution rounds, driver/vehicle/loading coordination, bill-copy/outstanding follow-ups, dealer "scheme" push calls to Rajesh's sub-dealers, and garbled production-floor chatter about sheet lengths and bends. Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales/enquiry conversations** — roughly 35–40 distinguishable customer enquiries plus a handful of dealer-pricing/negotiation calls. Given this, the signal below is built only from those real sales exchanges; coaching notes should be read as directional, not exhaustive, since the sample of true "closing" calls is thin.

Crayon Roofing & Structures operates out of **Manali / Andarkuppam check post, Chennai** (one branch only — repeatedly told to Coimbatore and Hyderabad callers that there is no outstation branch). They run two product lines from two factories: a **metal roofing sheet unit** (JSW/Asian coil-coated sheets, profile/accessories) and a separate unit that does **PUFF panel / tile-profile work**. They also stock and sell **screws (Tata Agri brand self-drilling/self-building screws)**, **welding rods (Tata)**, and occasionally quote on **polycarbonate (Lexan) sheets**, but are candid that **UPVC sheets and 0.6mm/80GSM GI sheet variants are "not our product."**

## Products & brand ladder
- **Metal Roofing Sheets (core product)** — JSW-sourced coil, sold under in-house/partner brand names:
  - **JSW Color On Plus** — flagship, thickness 0.47mm most common; also 0.45mm, 0.50mm, 0.6mm.
  - **JSW Pragathi / Pragathi Color On Plus** — slightly premium brand line.
  - **JSW Radiance / Silver On Plus** — alternate JSW sub-brands, "ரெண்டுமே JSW தான்... Silver-on கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம்."
  - **Asian Indra Dhanush (AZ, 70 GSM, ISI)** — budget/entry sheet, "வெறும் Indra Dhanush தான் வரும்... AZ70GSM ISI symbol இருக்கும்."
  - Colours mentioned: Sky Blue (most common), Off White, Royal Blue, Grey/dark green ("Kali Shelt Green"), Terracotta.
- **Profile / Tile-profile sheets** — handled at a different factory ("நம்மளோட இன்னொரு factory-ல tile profile sheet-ஓட இது இருக்கு").
- **PUFF insulated panels (Roof + Wall)** — 50mm/40mm/30mm thickness; priced per running/square meter, ~₹1650+GST/sq.m (works out ~₹2000 all-in). Warranty/claim details are escalated internally ("அந்த details எல்லாமே கேட்டுட்டு நான் உங்களுக்கு inform பண்றேன்").
- **Accessories** — L-flash, Ridge, Gutter, Cutter (all usually "standard width 16mm/610mm"; custom widths >610mm trigger **double rate** because full sheet width must be used).
- **Polycarbonate (Lexan) sheets** — 1.5mm/1.8mm/2mm "bare," and 2mm clear/transparent; **15 ft is the hard standard max length** — cannot be extended.
- **Screws** — Tata Agri-Go self-drilling/self-building screws (1 inch, 2 inch, M8x55mm full-thread, 25mm); rust-free variant also sold.
- **Welding rods** — Tata brand, sold to retail dealers with monthly "schemes"/targets.
- **Not offered**: UPVC sheet, GI 80GSM "regular spangle," MS corrugated 1.2mm (redirected to "metal roofing sheet தான் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m** (one quote) vs **₹445 + GST / sq.m** for Pragathi branded 0.47 (different calls — brand-tiered pricing).
- JSW sheet via kg: **₹118–120/kg + GST**; square-meter equivalent quoted as **₹435 + GST**.
- Asian Indra Dhanush Force .45: **₹370 + GST / sq.m**.
- Asian Indra Dhanush (10ft sheet, old/entry): **₹1251 + 18% GST** per sheet + loading charge.
- Pragathi Sky Blue: **₹410 + GST / sq.m → ₹484 with 18% GST**.
- Profile coil (Indra Dhanush): **₹101 + tax**; coil-only rate **₹3 less (~₹98)**.
- L-flash/cutter/ridge: standard 610mm width = **₹655**; if width adds to >610mm (uses full sheet) = **double rate** (seen as ₹1310 for a 900mm cutter).
- Polycarbonate 2mm (12ft, bare): **₹800 + GST / sq.m**.
- PUFF 50mm: **₹1650 + GST / sq.m** (~₹2000 all-in with GST).
- Screws: 1 inch Tata Agri — **₹2.93 + tax**; 2 inch — **₹4.44–₹4.66 + tax**; M8x55 full-thread — **₹4.44/4.66 + tax**; carton (~2500 pcs) ≈ **₹2500–2600**.
- Welding rod: consumer ~**₹356/packet incl. tax** (was ₹336); dealer purchase rate quoted around **₹300–330**.
- **Payment terms (quoted to a genuine B2B enquiry)**: "**50% advance payment, balance 50% before delivery**"; "**vehicle/transport is 100% customer's scope**" — Crayon does not deliver.
- **No cash/no-GST billing**: explicitly refused — "without GST பண்ண முடியாது... with GST தான் full-ஆவே."
- Long-distance orders (e.g., Tirunelveli) are discouraged: "ரொம்ப long distance-ஆ இருக்கும்...local-லயே check பண்ணி பார்க்கலாம்."

## Objection Playbook
1. **"Cash bill-ல பண்ண முடியுமா?" (avoid GST)**
   → Firm no: *"இல்ல sir. without GST பண்ண முடியாது. with GST தான் full-ஆவே."* No bending on this across multiple calls.
2. **"Rate ரொம்ப அதிகமா இருக்கே" / price shock on accessories**
   → Explain the technical reason (full-width sheet use = double rate) rather than just discounting: *"full sheet-ஐயும் use பண்ணிதான் இந்த cutter பண்ற மாதிரி இருக்
